key_findings: Melatonin and selenium reduce docetaxel-induced mechanical and heat neuropathic pain in mice.
Docetaxel toxicity in DRG/SH-SY5Y cells (ROS, apoptosis, Ca2+) depends on TRPV1 expression and is reduced by MT and Se.
